data.description: You are accustomed to riding while wearing armor, and your armor doesn't hinder your riding skills.
data.name: Armored Rider

raw_tokens.value: You are accustomed to riding while wearing armor, and your armor doesn't hinder your riding skills.

You don't take the usual armor check penalty on Ride checks. If you are knocked unconscious while in a saddle, you always remain in the saddle. Normal: If you are knocked unconscious while riding, you have a 50%% chance to stay in the saddle (75%% if you're in a military saddle).
